title: Water Supply & Wastewater Treatment – Five Project References
summary: Five water infrastructure and industrial wastewater project references covering raw-water intake, pretreatment, underground wastewater treatment and zero-liquid discharge. Project participation details are under documentation review.
equipmentScope: Huaneng Zhengning: storage tanks and heat exchangers are listed in preliminary supplied records; supply confirmation and scope for all five references are pending.
body:
Selected Water Infrastructure Project References

The following five project references have been compiled from supplied project information for review. Publicly available descriptions do not establish Tongyang's involvement in every project. Tongyang's exact contract scope, equipment quantities and permission to identify project owners remain subject to verification. The list is presented for reference rather than as a claim that Tongyang acted as EPC contractor for all five projects.

1. Yanzidi Water Plant Renovation and Raw-Water Facilities

Project type: Raw-water intake, pumping and water plant infrastructure.

Project information provided: Water plant site works, raw-water pumping station (900,000 m³/day), raw-water intake pipelines and BIM design deliverables.

Verification status: Project identity, capacity, official name and Tongyang's involvement are not yet confirmed by accessible project documentation.

2. Dafeng Xintuan River Emergency Raw-Water Source Project

Project type: Emergency raw-water source and intake facilities.

Project information provided: 150,000 m³/day; described as a reconstruction project. The river name is Xintuan River (新团河).

Verification status: The proposed reconstruction description, project status and Tongyang's work scope require confirmation.

3. Dafeng Tongyu River Intake Upgrade and Enhanced Pretreatment

Project type: Raw-water intake improvement and pretreatment.

Project information provided: 100,000 m³/day; proposed biological pretreatment, conventional treatment and advanced treatment processes.

Verification status: A similarly named intake-upgrade project has been identified, but the stated capacity, process train and Tongyang's involvement require supporting documents.

4. Huayang Underground Wastewater Treatment Plant, Tianfu New Area, Sichuan

Project type: Municipal wastewater treatment.

Project information provided: 180,000 m³/day underground wastewater treatment plant.

Important clarification: This is a wastewater treatment project, not a drinking-water purification or raw-water source plant. Tongyang's actual participation has not yet been confirmed.

5. Huaneng Zhengning 2 × 1,000 MW Coal Power Project — Mine-Water Deep Treatment and ZLD

Project type: Industrial wastewater deep treatment, evaporation/crystallization and zero-liquid discharge.

Engineering partner named in preliminary records: Hezhongsi (Beijing) Environmental Engineering Co., Ltd.

Equipment recorded in the supplied preliminary list: Custom storage tanks and heat exchangers.

Verification status: Tongyang's purchase-order records, equipment quantities and permitted disclosure of its role should be confirmed before describing this as a completed supply reference.

Tongyang Equipment and EPC Collaboration

Tongyang manufactures project-specific storage tanks, pressure vessels, heat exchangers and other industrial equipment. For water treatment projects, its scope may include fabrication, inspection, technical documentation and engineering coordination. Overall EPC responsibility is not implied unless contractually established.

Contact Tongyang for detailed project and equipment references
